title: The Night in Bethlehem
reflectionQuestion: What do you think it was like in that quiet stable, the night the baby Jesus was born?
kidSafetyNotes: The NATIVITY -- a cornerstone the lane lacked (had wise_men 1809, not the birth itself). Hushed/peaceful telling (shepherds + angels are separate anchors, not here), tagged calm_peaceful to match the quiet holy-night register (bedtime-perfect). Same VOICE_MARY_PONDER as 1824 (Mary Says Yes) -- deliberate continuity, the same 'Mary' voice through both Mary stories. 'No room' kept gentle; stable cozy not grim. Luke 2:19 'held it in her heart' echo, softened ending. One image: baby Jesus asleep in the manger on the hay.
